description: This file defines a PHP class 'Auth_Container_ADOdb' that implements a storage driver for fetching login data from a database using the ADOdb PHP abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting to the database, fetching user data, adding/removing users, and listing users, specifically tailored to integrate with the ADOdb database library and PEAR error handling.

classes.name: Auth_Container_ADOdb
classes.description: A class implementing authentication data storage using ADOdb for PHP, supporting user retrieval, addition, removal, and listing through database operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection parameters; establishes connection via DSN or array options.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using the provided DSN string or array.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Ensures that a database connection is established before executing queries.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query object on the database.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for database connection and table parameters.

methods.name: _parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and applies configuration options passed to the constructor.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches user login data from the database based on username and password, verifying credentials.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of all users stored in the database.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a new user with specified username and password, plus optional additional data.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a user from the database based on username.
